ALPHABET GAMES · BEGINNING SOUNDS

Beginning Sounds — listen and find.

A letter on the left, three pictures to choose from: which one starts with that sound? Every round is phonetically honest — including X, which gets its own tricky-letter rules.

Letter A a — which picture starts with a — aaa?

Letter B b — which picture starts with b — buh?

Letter C c — which picture starts with c — kuh?

Letter D d — which picture starts with d — duh?

Letter E e — which picture starts with e — eh?

Letter F f — which picture starts with f — fff?

Letter G g — which picture starts with g — in giraffe it says j?

Letter H h — which picture starts with h — hhh?

Letter I i — which picture starts with i — ie?

Letter J j — which picture starts with j — juh?

Letter K k — which picture starts with k — kuh?

Letter L l — which picture starts with l — lll?

Letter M m — which picture starts with m — mmm?

Letter N n — which picture starts with n — nnn?

Letter O o — which picture starts with o — oh?

Letter P p — which picture starts with p — puh?

Letter Q q — which picture starts with q — kwuh?

Letter R r — which picture starts with r — rrr?

Letter S s — which picture starts with s — sss?

Letter T t — which picture starts with t — tuh?

Letter U u — which picture starts with u — uh?

Letter V v — which picture starts with v — vvv?

Letter W w — which picture starts with w — wuh?

X is a tricky letter — Xx marks xylophone! Which picture goes with the letter X?

Letter Y y — which picture starts with y — yuh?

Letter Z z — which picture starts with z — zzz?

HOW TO PLAY

Say it, then find it.

  1. 01

    Say the letter’s sound

    The big card on the left is the letter. Grown-ups read the line aloud and stretch the sound: mmm…

  2. 02

    Tap the picture that starts with it

    Wrong taps are welcome — the game just invites another look. There are no scores and nothing is lost.

  3. 03

    Meet the tricky letters

    G says j in giraffe, I says its name in ice cream, and X rarely starts words at all — its ks sound hides at the end of fox and box. Every card tells the truth.
